exceptions.mitigation: Development only: braces reaches apps/web solely through ts-prune (ts-morph, fast-glob, micromatch), which the dead-code check runs over Weir's own source with fixed glob patterns. Nothing in the shipped web app or server uses it, and no outside input reaches those patterns. No fixed braces release exists yet (every version up to 3.0.3 is affected); approved by the owner on 2026-10-03 for 30 days.
